texts.text: This is {callsign}. On course. All onboard systems nominal. Please confirm contact.
这里是{callsign}。航向正常，船载系统运行正常。请求通信确认。
Copy. Continue on your planned course.
Copy. Reading you loud and clear.
{callsign} 呼叫殖民地。收到请回复。
Earth Control, no response from the colony. Should I continue the mission?
地球联络部，殖民地没有回应。是否继续任务？
Continue the mission. Maintain your current course and keep trying to establish contact.
继续任务。保持当前航向，继续尝试联络。
This is {callsign}. On course. Still no response from the colony. Please confirm whether I should continue the mission.
这里是{callsign}。航向正常。殖民地仍未回应，请确认是否继续任务。
Copy. Try hailing the colony again.
收到。请再次尝试呼叫殖民地。
{callsign} to colony. Do you read? I repeat, do you read?
{callsign} 呼叫殖民地。收到请回复。重复，收到请回复。
This is {callsign}, en route to the colony as scheduled. Report your situation.
这里是{callsign}，正按计划前往殖民地。请报告你们的情况。
There's been... an accident... Everyone... only...
这里……出了意外……所有人都……只剩……
信号失真。部分语音无法辨识。
What happened to everyone? Say again.
你说所有人怎么了？请重复。
{callsign}, your mission has changed. Land near the colony and investigate the incident.
{callsign}，任务变更。你需要在殖民地附近着陆，调查事故情况。
Take all emergency supplies. Once you've landed, prioritize restoring communications with Earth.
带齐应急物资。着陆后，优先恢复与地球的通信。
Your return window is limited. Allow enough time for departure. We cannot guarantee a rescue after that window closes.
返航窗口有限。务必预留返航时间，我们无法保证窗口关闭后的救援。
Copy. Expecting Mars orbit in {hours} hours. Beginning landing preparations.
收到。预计 {hours} 小时后进入火星轨道，开始准备着陆。
Colony, if you can hear me, I need calibration data for the landing zone.
殖民地，如果你能听见，我需要着陆区的校准数据。
Descent underway. No time remains to wait for calibration data.
已进入下降阶段。无法继续等待校准数据。
Awaiting the final set of terrain calibration data.
等待最后一组地形校准数据。
{callsign} to colony. Data transfer interrupted. Please resend the final set of calibration data.
{callsign} 呼叫殖民地。数据传输中断，请重新发送最后一组校准数据。
I need that data to confirm the landing site. Try again. Send whatever you can.
我需要这些数据确认着陆点。请再试一次，先把能发送的部分传过来。
Connection unstable. Terrain calibration data incomplete.
连接不稳定。地形校准数据不完整。
Landing complete. Location: near the colony.
着陆完成。位置：殖民地附近。
Damage assessment: severe structural damage to the landing craft.
损伤检测：舱体严重受损。
This is Pioneer-60. Something went wrong during landing. I'm trapped in the lander. I need rescue!
这里是 Pioneer-60。着陆出了意外，我被困在着陆舱里了，需要救援！
Hello. How may I help you?
您好，有什么可以帮您的吗？
Wait. Who are you? What happened to the colony? Why did communications go down?
等等，你是谁？殖民地出了什么事？通信为什么中断了？
I am the colony's AI assistant. A serious accident occurred at the colony. All registered personnel have died.
我是殖民地的 AI 助手。殖民地发生了严重事故，所有登记人员均已丧生。

I tried to respond to your transmissions two days ago, but the communications console was designed for human operation only. Bypassing its restrictions and taking control took some time. I also appear to have accidentally burned out some communications components in the process, causing the unstable connection.
两天前，我曾尝试回应您的通信，但通信控制台仅允许人类操作。我花了一些时间绕过限制并接管系统。在此过程中，我似乎还意外烧坏了一些通信元件，导致连接不稳定。
I have granted your device full access to the colony's systems. You can now control all colony facilities through your terminal. I will assist you however I can.
我已向您的设备开放殖民地系统的全部权限。您现在可以通过终端控制所有殖民地设施，我会尽力提供协助。

How could this have happened? Now that I know the situation, I need to begin the return mission. You're the AI assistant recovered from the ancient ruins, right? Can you assess my situation and find a solution?
怎么会这样？既然已经了解情况，我需要开始返航任务。你应该就是从古代遗迹里发现的 AI 助手，对吧？能分析一下我目前的情况，找出解决办法吗？
I've detected severe damage to your ship. I'm afraid it cannot simply take off and return home, but I can help you repair it. Some facilities aboard the space station are still operational.
我检测到你的飞船损坏严重，恐怕无法直接起飞返航。但我可以帮你修复，空间站内仍有一些可用设施。
Earth Control said our return window was limited. How much time do we have?
地球联络部说我们的返航窗口有限。我们还有多少时间？
Today is 25 August 1981. The navigation archive lists 3 to 13 September as the planned Mars-to-Earth departure period.
今天是 1981 年 8 月 25 日。导航档案中登记的、计划中的火星—地球出发时段是 9 月 3 日至 13 日。
Why those dates? Can't we just leave when the repairs are done?
为什么非得是那几天？不能修好就走吗？

I will explain it in the plainest, most direct terms possible. Repairs can make the ship work again. They cannot replace the fuel we have lost. With our remaining fuel margin, this low-energy return plan is our only viable option for this departure period.
我会用最直白、最不绕弯子的话解释。修复能让飞船重新运转，但补不回已经损失掉的燃料。以我们剩下的燃料余量，这个低能耗返航方案是本次出发时段唯一可行的选择。
After the cutoff calculated for this ship, the required trajectory adjustments would exceed the margin I can safely commit. Firing the engine is not the same as getting home.
一旦超过按这艘飞船算出的截止时刻，所需的轨道调整量就会超出我能安全动用的余量。点燃引擎，并不等于回得了家。
Then when is the next chance?
那下一次机会是什么时候？

The next return plan listed in the archive is dated 9 to 19 November 1983. That is about two years and two months after this window. It is a reference for replanning, not a guarantee. We would have to reassess whether this damaged ship could use it.
档案里登记的下一个返航方案是 1983 年 11 月 9 日至 19 日。那大约是这个窗口之后两年零两个月。它只是重新规划时的参考，不是保证。还得重新评估这艘受损的飞船能不能用上它。

Your emergency supplies will not last that long. Earth has also told us that rescue cannot be guaranteed after this window closes. If we stay, we will have to restore the colony's life support, water recycling and food production.
你的应急物资撑不到那时候。地球也说过，窗口关闭后无法保证救援。如果留下来，我们就得恢复殖民地的生命维持、水循环和食物生产。
Then let's make this window. Tell me what needs fixing.
那就抓住这个窗口。告诉我该修什么。
Assess the damage to the ship and put together a repair plan. Help me repair it so I can return to Earth.
帮我评估飞船的损坏情况，制定修复计划。帮我修好它，让我回到地球。
Understood. Objective received. I will explain everything in the plainest, most direct terms possible. I have taken control of your ship's information systems and am preparing a repair plan.
明白，任务目标已接收。我会用最直白、最直接的方式解释一切。我已接管你飞船的信息系统，正在制定修复计划。
First, repair the power unit to restore full power to the ship, along with the interstellar navigation system. Then repair the propulsion engine, and finally the life support system.
首先修复能源装置，恢复飞船的全部供电，以及修复星际导航系统。然后修复推进引擎，最后修复生命维持系统。
I have put the repair plan on the calendar beside your seat. It runs from 25 August to 13 September: twenty dates. Power, navigation, propulsion, life support. The sequence has not changed.
我已经把修复计划放在你座位旁边的日历上。从 8 月 25 日到 9 月 13 日，一共二十格日期。能源、导航、推进、生命维持，顺序没有变。
9 月 13 日为什么被圈出来了？
That is the deadline. When each day ends, I will cross out its date in red. There is only one circle. It marks the last day.
那是截止日。每过完一天，我会用红笔把对应的日期划掉。整张日历只有一个圈，它标的是最后一天。

The amber instrument beside it is labeled LATEST DEPARTURE. It counts down to the last moment you can authorize departure. The allowance for surface ascent and reaching orbit is already included. You do not need to calculate it separately.
旁边那台琥珀色的仪表标着 LATEST DEPARTURE。它倒数的是你能授权启航的最后时刻。地表上升和进入轨道的预留量已经算进去了，你不用自己再算。
We can launch early and enter a waiting orbit, then perform the Earth-return burn during the planned window. You do not have to sit here until the last day.
可以提前发射，进入等待轨道，然后在计划窗口内做地球返航点火。你不必在这儿干等到最后一天。
Once repairs are complete, you must still select Launch yourself. Your authorization must reach me before the countdown reaches zero.
修复完成后，启航仍然必须由你自己选。你的授权要在倒计时归零之前送到我这儿。
You can now send out the Mars rover to continue collecting materials. I will explain how. Enter "collect" in the terminal.
你现在可以派出火星车，继续采集材料。我会说明如何操作。请在终端输入“collect”。
I will explain everything in the plainest, most direct terms possible. You can now repair the power compartment.
我会用最直白、最直接的方式解释一切。你现在可以修复能源舱了。
Why do you talk like some old AI from the early twenty-first century? Was that some strange quirk of your creator's? It's unsettling, especially when your appearance is actually quite well designed.
你怎么说起话来像二十一世纪初的某种老式 AI？这是你创造者的什么怪癖吗？真诡异，明明你的外貌设计还挺不错的。
What do you know? It's called old tech.
你懂什么？这叫 old tech。
Yeah, very old tech. Only an AI dug out of ancient ruins would talk like that. Anyway, how do I start the repairs?
是啊，确实很 old tech。只有从古代遗迹里挖出来的 AI 才会这么说话。好了，我该怎么开始修复？

Enter "inventory" to check your supplies. For the power unit, you need 6 Rolled Electromechanical Alloy Sheets, 4 Tinned Copper Wire & Windings, 2 Precision Drive Gear Blanks, 7 Heat-Resistant Ceramic Insulators, and 3 Vulcanized Airtight Rubber Liners.
输入“inventory”查看库存。修复能源装置需要：轧制机电合金板 6 个、镀锡铜导线与绕组铜材 4 个、精密传动齿轮坯 2 个、耐热绝缘陶瓷件 7 个、硫化气密橡胶衬料 3 个。
Once you have everything, enter "assemble" to begin. If you forget a command, enter "help" to see the list.
材料齐全后，输入“assemble”开始。忘记指令时，输入“help”查看列表。
Twenty Earth-standard days are compressed into twenty minutes of active work. Story reading pauses the mission clock and all work. Salvage, repairs and ordinary status queries consume time.
二十个地球标准日压缩为二十分钟的有效操作时间。剧情阅读期间，任务计时与所有作业都会暂停；回收、维修与普通状态查询会消耗时间。
The clock will start when you select BEGIN REPAIRS after this briefing.
计时会在简报结束后、你选择 BEGIN REPAIRS 时启动。
Return reference period archived: 03-13 SEP 1981. Surface ascent and orbital preparation allowances will be assessed after landing.
返航参考时段已归档：1981 年 9 月 3 日至 13 日。地表上升与入轨的预留量将在着陆后评估。
Half of our departure preparation time has passed. The calendar has been updated.
出发准备时间已经过半。日历已更新。
Only one quarter of our original preparation time remains before the departure cutoff.
距离最晚启航时刻，最初准备时间只剩四分之一。
Final time warning. One tenth of our original preparation time remains.
最后的时间警告。最初准备时间只剩十分之一。
The power unit is still awaiting repair. Check your inventory, then prepare the assembly.
能源装置仍未修复。检查仓库，然后准备组装。
The interstellar navigation system is next. Check your inventory, then prepare the assembly.
接下来是星际导航系统。检查仓库，然后准备组装。
The propulsion engine is next. Check your inventory, then prepare the assembly.
接下来是推进引擎。检查仓库，然后准备组装。
The life support system is next. Check your inventory, then prepare the assembly.
接下来是生命维持装置。检查仓库，然后准备组装。
You are still short of materials. Check the remaining requirements in your inventory before sending out the rover.
材料还不够。先看看仓库里还差什么，再派出火星车。
You have the required materials. Complete the current assembly.
材料已经齐了。完成当前的组装。
Some systems have not passed their checks. I will keep helping, but I cannot move the deadline.
还有系统没有通过检查。我会继续帮忙，但截止日我挪不动。
All four systems have passed their checks. Return to the terminal and select Launch. We can still leave.
四套系统全部通过检查。回到终端，选择启航。我们还来得及走。

Sorry. I just tested the engine. I wasn't expecting it to be so powerful. I hope I didn't startle you. I've also adjusted the ship's attitude for flight. Once repairs are complete, you can start it up.
抱歉，我刚测试了一下引擎，没想到它这么强劲。希望没有吓到你。我也已经把飞船调整到可飞行姿态。修复完成后，就可以启动它了。
That was only a test. We have not launched. The deadline on the calendar still applies.
那只是试车。我们没有发射。日历上的截止日仍然有效。
Unable to launch: departure window closed.
无法启航：返航窗口已关闭。
The ship is fully repaired. You can now return home. I won't miss you. Goodbye.
飞船已全部修复。你现在可以返航了。我不会想念你的。再见。
The ship lifts away from the surface. The colony and its broken transmissions slowly fall behind you.
飞船升离地表。殖民地和它断断续续的通信，在你身后缓缓退去。
You reach the waiting orbit. When the planned return window arrives, the Earth-return burn begins.
你进入等待轨道。等到计划中的返航窗口，地球返航点火开始。
The ship climbs from the surface into orbit. Within the planned return window, the Earth-return burn begins.
飞船从地表升入轨道。在计划中的返航窗口内，地球返航点火开始。
Earth is still far away. You do not know what you will find when you get there.
地球仍然很远。你不知道到那里会看到什么。
But you are finally on your way home.
但你终于踏上了回家的路。
The window has closed. We cannot make this departure.
窗口关闭了。这一次我们走不了。
Check again. Is there another route?
再查一遍。还有别的路线吗？
I have checked. With the ship in its present condition and the fuel we have left, I cannot give you an alternative route we can safely fly.
查过了。以飞船现在的状态和我们剩下的燃料，我给不出能安全飞行的替代路线。
Then we wait for the next one.
The next return plan in the archive is in November 1983. That means more than two years of waiting, and the ship would need to be reassessed. Your emergency supplies will not last that long.
档案里的下一个返航方案在 1983 年 11 月。那意味着两年多的等待，而且飞船还得重新评估。你的应急物资撑不了那么久。
We will keep trying to restore contact. But in their last transmission, they said they could not guarantee rescue after the window closed.
我们会继续尝试恢复通信。但在最后一次通信里，他们说过窗口关闭后无法保证救援。
I will explain it in the plainest, most direct terms possible. Your first priority now is to stay alive until we can try to leave again.
我会用最直白、最不绕弯子的话说清楚。你现在最优先的事，是活到我们能再次尝试离开。
That part I understand. Give me the plan.
First, check the lander's air supply and power. Then restore whatever water recycling equipment we can use in the colony. Until then, we will keep you alive with the facilities that still work.
先检查着陆舱的空气供应和电力。然后恢复殖民地里还能用的水循环设备。在那之前，我们靠还能运转的设施维持你的生命。
After that, repair the greenhouse and check the seed reserves. Emergency rations are not enough. We need to start producing food.
之后修复温室，检查种子储备。应急口粮不够，我们必须开始生产食物。
From repairing a ship to growing things.
The original objective has not been canceled. We just need a different schedule first.
最初的任务目标并没有取消。我们只是得先换一份日程。
Then tell me what we do first tomorrow.
那就告诉我，明天先做什么。
Check the greenhouse water supply. If it is usable, prepare to sow.
检查温室的供水。如果还能用，就准备播种。
Outside, the colony is still empty.
外面，殖民地依然空无一人。
Tomorrow, you will prepare to plant the first seed.
明天，你将准备种下第一粒种子。

A bank of brass-rimmed analog gauges beneath a curved, dust-protective glass cover coated with space dust. Slender needles sit frozen against faded scales, with levers and tiny adjustment knobs protruding from the side. Aboard the colony ships of the old era, it served as the senses of an entire compartment, providing readings of pressure, energy flux, and temperature.
一组带黄铜边框的模拟仪表，弧形防尘玻璃罩上蒙着宇宙尘埃。细长指针停在褪色刻度上，侧面伸出拨杆和微型调节旋钮。在旧时代的殖民飞船上，它是整座舱段的感官，提供压力、能量通量和温度读数。

A heavy cast-iron case houses several clear glass vacuum tubes behind its front grille. The tuning dial's etched markings are worn, and much of the speaker diaphragm is dry and cracked. It was once the sole communications link for a distant interstellar colony, receiving broadcasts from the homeworld across the void. After the old era ended, this receiver became a symbol of romance. Now, it is only good for salvaging the copper and insulating components inside.
厚重的铸铁机箱里，几支透明玻璃真空管立在正面格栅后方。调谐转盘上的蚀刻刻度已经磨损，喇叭振膜大部分干燥开裂。它曾是遥远星际殖民地唯一的通信联系，接收母星跨越虚空传来的广播。旧时代结束后，这台接收机成了浪漫的象征。如今，它只适合拆取内部的铜材与绝缘件。

A boxy metal housing covered in scorch marks, densely packed with electromagnetic relays, copper terminals, and stepping dials. This was an ancient civilization's primitive logic center, opening and closing contacts to transmit signals and coordinate the compartment's electromechanical equipment. It could perform complex timing control without silicon chips. Remarkable.
一个方形金属壳，外面布满灼痕，里面密集装着电磁继电器、铜质接线端子和步进拨轮。这是古文明的原始逻辑中枢，通过触点开合传递信号，协调舱内的机电设备。不用硅芯片，就能完成复杂的时序控制。真了不起。

A tangled cluster of metal pipes fitted with needle valves and corrugated pressure bellows. Hardened sealing gaskets still cling to its connections. It once carried oxygen, cooling water, and propellant, sustaining life within the compartment and keeping the engines running.
一簇交错缠绕的金属管路，装有针阀和褶皱压力波纹管，接口上仍附着已经硬化的密封垫圈。它曾输送氧气、冷却水和推进剂，维持舱内生命与引擎运转。

A thick, heavy cast-iron outer cylinder lined with large slabs of grayish-white insulating ceramic. Aged rubber gaskets are pressed into its seams, and dark brown marks from scorching heat stain the surface. It once encased a thermoelectric power core, insulating the surrounding hull structure from its fearsome heat. This outer sleeve is safe and provides heat-resistant material essential for building a power unit.
厚重的铸铁外筒内衬大块灰白色隔热陶瓷，老化的橡胶垫片压在接缝里，表面留有高温造成的深褐色灼痕。它曾包裹热电能源核心，隔绝可怕的高温，保护周围船体结构。这层外衬是安全的，提供建造能源装置所必需的耐热材料。

How much time do we have?
下一次机会是什么时候？
Why do you sound so old?
你说话的腔调怎么这么老派？
Copy. Expecting Mars orbit tomorrow. Beginning landing preparations.
收到。预计明天进入火星轨道，开始准备着陆。
All inhabited sectors are silent. No crew transponders. No response from the surface relay.
所有有人居住的星区都沉默了。没有船员应答信号。地表中继台也没有任何回应。

Checking propulsion, reserves and the departure assembly. There is a problem.
正在检查推进、储备和启航组件。出问题了。
Close the log. We still have work to do.
关掉日志吧，我们还有活要干。
Colony control, this is the return craft. Does anyone read me?
殖民地控制台，这里是返航船。有人能收到吗？
DEPARTURE ACCEPTED. The countdown has stopped at your authorization time. Ascent to the waiting orbit is cleared.
启航已接受。倒计时停在你授权的那一刻。可以上升进入等待轨道。
Departure authorization. The assembly must remain complete, and the latest-departure clock must be above zero. Your confirmation is registered at the moment you select it.
启航授权。启航组件必须保持完整，最晚启航计时必须大于零。你的确认在按下那一刻生效。
Explain the departure window once more.
Give me a schedule. We are not staying here.
给我一份日程。我们不会留在这儿。
I do not know. I will keep listening.
我不知道。我会继续听着。
Keep the log. Someone should remember them.
留着日志。总得有人记得他们。
Let me read the last colony log.
让我看看殖民地最后的日志。
MOUSE: look around. E: connect or leave this terminal. ESC: return from a workstation, close the terminal, or pause the mission.
鼠标：环视。E：连接或离开终端。ESC：从工作台返回、关闭终端，或暂停任务。
Mission channel ready. The clock is running. Check the calendar and the amber departure instrument beside your seat.
任务频道就绪，计时已经开始。看看日历，还有你座位旁那台琥珀色的启航仪表。
Not yet. Return to the mission channel.

Our navigation archive lists 03-13 SEP 1981 for the planned Mars-to-Earth departure. The lower-energy route is the only one inside our remaining fuel budget. Missing our cutoff would demand more fuel than we can safely commit.
导航档案里登记的、计划中的火星—地球出发时段是 1981 年 9 月 3 日至 13 日。低能耗路线是剩余燃料预算里唯一可行的。错过截止时刻，所需燃料会超出我能安全动用的量。
Reading the live mission instruments. The remaining time and assembly report follow in the system channel. Querying does not stop the clock.
正在读取实时任务仪表。剩余时间和组装报告随后发到系统频道。查询不会让计时停下。
Report the time remaining and the assembly status.
报告剩余时间和组装状态。
Saved. Your work will resume when you leave this reading window.
已保存。离开这个阅读窗口后，你的工作会继续。
Start the clock. I am ready.
Tell me what we have left.

The amber instrument marks our LATEST DEPARTURE authorization. The circled date is {LAST_DATE}; the ascent allowance is already reserved. If we repair early, we can launch to a waiting orbit, then make the Earth-return burn inside the planned window.
那台琥珀色仪表标的是最晚启航授权。被圈出的日期是 {LAST_DATE}；上升段的预留量已经算进去了。如果提前修完，可以先发射进入等待轨道，再在计划窗口内做地球返航点火。
The colony is below us. We reach the waiting orbit. Later, inside the planned return window, the Earth-return burn carries us away from Mars.
殖民地在下方。我们进入等待轨道。之后，在计划中的返航窗口内，地球返航点火带我们离开火星。
The countdown begins when you select BEGIN MISSION. Completing repairs will not launch the craft. You must return here and confirm departure before the clock reaches zero.
倒计时在你选择 BEGIN MISSION 时开始。修完设备不会自动发射。你必须在计时归零前回到这里确认启航。
The damaged propulsion system has very little fuel margin. Rebuild the departure assembly, and we can still reach a low-energy Earth-return trajectory.
受损的推进系统几乎没有燃料余量。重建启航组件，我们还能进入低能耗的地球返航轨道。
The departure assembly reports complete. That is enough for the low-energy return plan. We can leave as soon as you authorize departure; the window is still counting down.
启航组件报告完整，已经够低能耗返航方案用了。你一授权我们就能走；窗口还在倒计时。
The greenhouse still has a sealed seed cabinet. We can bring its water loop back online. I have made a new entry on the calendar.
温室里还有一个密封的种子柜。我们可以把它那套水循环重新开起来。我已经在日历上加了新的一条。
The next period in our navigation study is {NEXT_OPPORTUNITY}. We must reassess the craft before using it. Stored food will not last that long. I am sorry.
导航研究里的下一个时段是 {NEXT_OPPORTUNITY}。用之前必须重新评估这艘飞船。储备食物撑不到那时候。抱歉。

The next return period listed in the study is {NEXT_OPPORTUNITY}: more than two years later. It is a planning reference, not a guarantee for this damaged craft. Our stored food cannot cover that wait. We would have to restore the greenhouse.
研究里登记的下一个返航时段是 {NEXT_OPPORTUNITY}，要在两年多以后。它只是规划参考，对这艘受损飞船不作保证。储备食物撑不过那段等待，我们得先把温室恢复起来。

The paper calendar runs from {START_DATE} through {LAST_DATE}: {DAY_COUNT} dated workdays. The cells use MONTH/DAY, not numbered mission days. I will add a red cross after each date has ended. Only the final deadline is circled.
纸质日历从 {START_DATE} 排到 {LAST_DATE}，共 {DAY_COUNT} 个标注日期。格子用的是月/日，不是任务第几天。每过完一天，我会补一个红叉。只有最后期限被圈出来。
The route gets us away from Mars. I cannot promise what waits at Earth. Shall we go?
这条路线能带我们离开火星。地球那边等着什么，我不敢保证。走吗？

The simulation compresses {DAY_COUNT} Earth-standard 24-hour dates into {ACTIVE_MINUTES} minutes of active work. Explicit story reading pauses the mission and all work. Repairs, salvage and ordinary terminal queries use time.
这个模拟把 {DAY_COUNT} 个地球标准日压缩成 {ACTIVE_MINUTES} 分钟的有效操作时间。明确的剧情阅读会暂停任务和所有作业。维修、回收和普通终端查询会消耗时间。
Then I want to go home.
Then tell me what we do tomorrow.
There is no departure entry after this recording. I cannot tell you where they went.
这段记录之后没有启航条目。我无法告诉你他们去了哪里。
WINDOW CLOSED. We can no longer commit to this return plan with the fuel margin available.
窗口已关闭。以现有的燃料余量，我们无法再执行这个返航方案。
You do not know whether home still remembers you. But at last, you are on your way back.
你不知道故乡是否还记得你。但至少，你终于踏上了返程。
1. RECOVER: salvage optional supplies if you can spare the time. The repair parts are already at the workstation; extra supplies are not required to depart.
